             BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'invalid approval state'); END

CREATE TRIGGER durable_approvals_delete AFTER DELETE ON approvals BEGIN
           SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM metadata WHERE kind=14 AND integer_key=1)
          OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM metadata WHERE kind=2 AND integer_key=1)
          THEN RAISE(ABORT,'missing durable clock singleton') END;
           UPDATE metadata SET sync_generation=MAX(sync_generation,(SELECT MAX((SELECT COALESCE(MAX("publication_seq"),0) FROM "publications"),
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("sync_generation"),0) FROM "metadata" WHERE "kind"=14 AND "integer_key"=1),
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("sequence"),0) FROM "changes" INDEXED BY "changes_durable_sequence" WHERE kind = 1)) AS "publication_seq")) WHERE kind=14 AND integer_key=1;
           UPDATE metadata SET durable_floor=MAX(durable_floor,(SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM changes WHERE kind=1 AND deleted=1 AND deleted_at<CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)-7776000))
             WHERE kind=2 AND integer_key=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changes WHERE kind=1 AND deleted=1 AND deleted_at<CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)-7776000);
           DELETE FROM changes WHERE kind=1 AND deleted=1 AND deleted_at<CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)-7776000;
           INSERT INTO changes(kind,identity,source_rowid,source_label,durable_id,sequence,deleted,deleted_at,scope)
             SELECT 1,CAST((CASE typeof('approvals') WHEN 'null' THEN 'n' WHEN 'integer' THEN 'i' WHEN 'text' THEN 't' WHEN 'blob' THEN 'b' ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'unsupported migration key storage') END || printf('%016X',coalesce(length(CAST('approvals' AS BLOB)),0)) || hex(CAST('approvals' AS BLOB))) || (CASE typeof(OLD.id) WHEN 'null' THEN 'n' WHEN 'integer' THEN 'i' WHEN 'text' THEN 't' WHEN 'blob' THEN 'b' ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'unsupported migration key storage') END || printf('%016X',coalesce(length(CAST(OLD.id AS BLOB)),0)) || hex(CAST(OLD.id AS BLOB))) AS BLOB),
               COALESCE((SELECT source_rowid FROM changes WHERE kind=1 AND identity=CAST((CASE typeof('approvals') WHEN 'null' THEN 'n' WHEN 'integer' THEN 'i' WHEN 'text' THEN 't' WHEN 'blob' THEN 'b' ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'unsupported migration key storage') END || printf('%016X',coalesce(length(CAST('approvals' AS BLOB)),0)) || hex(CAST('approvals' AS BLOB))) || (CASE typeof(OLD.id) WHEN 'null' THEN 'n' WHEN 'integer' THEN 'i' WHEN 'text' THEN 't' WHEN 'blob' THEN 'b' ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'unsupported migration key storage') END || printf('%016X',coalesce(length(CAST(OLD.id AS BLOB)),0)) || hex(CAST(OLD.id AS BLOB))) AS BLOB)),
                 CASE WHEN typeof((SELECT COALESCE(MAX(source_rowid),0) FROM changes WHERE kind=1)+1)='integer' THEN (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(source_rowid),0) FROM changes WHERE kind=1)+1 ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'durable source rowid exhausted') END),
               'approvals',OLD.id,CASE WHEN typeof((SELECT MAX((SELECT COALESCE(MAX("publication_seq"),0) FROM "publications"),
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("sync_generation"),0) FROM "metadata" WHERE "kind"=14 AND "integer_key"=1),
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("sequence"),0) FROM "changes" INDEXED BY "changes_durable_sequence" WHERE kind = 1)) AS "publication_seq")+1)='integer' THEN (SELECT MAX((SELECT COALESCE(MAX("publication_seq"),0) FROM "publications"),
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("sync_generation"),0) FROM "metadata" WHERE "kind"=14 AND "integer_key"=1),
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("sequence"),0) FROM "changes" INDEXED BY "changes_durable_sequence" WHERE kind = 1)) AS "publication_seq")+1 ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'durable sequence exhausted') END,1,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER),json_object('agent',OLD.agent)
             WHERE 1
             ON CONFLICT(kind,identity) DO UPDATE SET sequence=excluded.sequence,deleted=excluded.deleted,deleted_at=excluded.deleted_at,scope=excluded.scope; 
         END

CREATE TRIGGER durable_runtime_requests_delete AFTER DELETE ON runtime_requests BEGIN
           SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM metadata WHERE kind=14 AND integer_key=1)
          OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM metadata WHERE kind=2 AND integer_key=1)
          THEN RAISE(ABORT,'missing durable clock singleton') END;
           UPDATE metadata SET sync_generation=MAX(sync_generation,(SELECT MAX((SELECT COALESCE(MAX("publication_seq"),0) FROM "publications"),
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("sync_generation"),0) FROM "metadata" WHERE "kind"=14 AND "integer_key"=1),
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("sequence"),0) FROM "changes" INDEXED BY "changes_durable_sequence" WHERE kind = 1)) AS "publication_seq")) WHERE kind=14 AND integer_key=1;
           UPDATE metadata SET durable_floor=MAX(durable_floor,(SELECT MAX(sequence) FROM changes WHERE kind=1 AND deleted=1 AND deleted_at<CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)-7776000))
             WHERE kind=2 AND integer_key=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM changes WHERE kind=1 AND deleted=1 AND deleted_at<CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)-7776000);
           DELETE FROM changes WHERE kind=1 AND deleted=1 AND deleted_at<CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)-7776000;
           INSERT INTO changes(kind,identity,source_rowid,source_label,durable_id,sequence,deleted,deleted_at,scope)
             SELECT 1,CAST((CASE typeof('runtime_requests') WHEN 'null' THEN 'n' WHEN 'integer' THEN 'i' WHEN 'text' THEN 't' WHEN 'blob' THEN 'b' ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'unsupported migration key storage') END || printf('%016X',coalesce(length(CAST('runtime_requests' AS BLOB)),0)) || hex(CAST('runtime_requests' AS BLOB))) || (CASE typeof(OLD.id) WHEN 'null' THEN 'n' WHEN 'integer' THEN 'i' WHEN 'text' THEN 't' WHEN 'blob' THEN 'b' ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'unsupported migration key storage') END || printf('%016X',coalesce(length(CAST(OLD.id AS BLOB)),0)) || hex(CAST(OLD.id AS BLOB))) AS BLOB),
               COALESCE((SELECT source_rowid FROM changes WHERE kind=1 AND identity=CAST((CASE typeof('runtime_requests') WHEN 'null' THEN 'n' WHEN 'integer' THEN 'i' WHEN 'text' THEN 't' WHEN 'blob' THEN 'b' ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'unsupported migration key storage') END || printf('%016X',coalesce(length(CAST('runtime_requests' AS BLOB)),0)) || hex(CAST('runtime_requests' AS BLOB))) || (CASE typeof(OLD.id) WHEN 'null' THEN 'n' WHEN 'integer' THEN 'i' WHEN 'text' THEN 't' WHEN 'blob' THEN 'b' ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'unsupported migration key storage') END || printf('%016X',coalesce(length(CAST(OLD.id AS BLOB)),0)) || hex(CAST(OLD.id AS BLOB))) AS BLOB)),

               'runtime_requests',OLD.id,CASE WHEN typeof((SELECT MAX((SELECT COALESCE(MAX("publication_seq"),0) FROM "publications"),
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("sync_generation"),0) FROM "metadata" WHERE "kind"=14 AND "integer_key"=1),
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("sequence"),0) FROM "changes" INDEXED BY "changes_durable_sequence" WHERE kind = 1)) AS "publication_seq")+1)='integer' THEN (SELECT MAX((SELECT COALESCE(MAX("publication_seq"),0) FROM "publications"),
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("sync_generation"),0) FROM "metadata" WHERE "kind"=14 AND "integer_key"=1),
            (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("sequence"),0) FROM "changes" INDEXED BY "changes_durable_sequence" WHERE kind = 1)) AS "publication_seq")+1 ELSE RAISE(ABORT,'durable sequence exhausted') END,1,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER),CASE WHEN json_valid(OLD.record) THEN json_object('agent',json((SELECT json_quote(value) FROM json_each(OLD.record) WHERE key='agent' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1))) END
